raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "cook at"
  role subject "Tunde"
  role location "the Botanical Garden in Oradea"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty supposed

@q query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "cook at"
    role subject ?x
    role location "the Botanical Garden in Oradea"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  except ?x "Tunde"
